(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, wherein the method is performed using a computing device.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user; and storing the second unique identifier in a data store in association with information regarding a particular instance of providing the product to the first user.

(Currently Amended) Claim 23: The method of claim 19, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the role of a user accessing the unique identifier.

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for the user as identified by the unique identifier. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 27: A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; a user interface configured to generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, wherein the system further comprises a data store configured to communicate with the computing device.
